INSERT INTO t_part (
                id, name, drawing_no, applicant_name, quantity,
                request_date, planned_delivery_date,
                status, is_urgent, customer_id, assembly_id,
                order_no, system_delivery_date, note,
                created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
            ) VALUES (
                $1, $2, $3, $4, $5,
                $6, $7,
                'PENDING', $8, $9, $10,
                $11, $12, $13,
                now(), $14, now(), $14
            )
            RETURNING id AS "id!"
